item.description: The AsyncResultBuilder incorrectly handles async_generator objects. The current implementation assumes all generators support the 'send' method, but async generators don't support send() and will raise AttributeError when attempted. This causes TypeError: 'async_generator' object is not an iterator in all async result builder tests.
item.contract: Modify AsyncResultBuilder._send method to properly detect and handle async generators vs regular generators. When an async generator is detected, it should use different iteration mechanisms (like awaiting __anext__ or using async for loops) rather than attempting to use send().
item.acceptance: tests/test_async_result_builder.py tests should pass without TypeError: 'async_generator' object is not an iterator

item.description: The AsyncOptionBuilder suffers from the same async generator handling issue as AsyncResultBuilder. It also incorrectly attempts to use send() method on async generators, causing TypeError: 'async_generator' object is not an iterator in all async option builder tests.
item.contract: Modify AsyncOptionBuilder._send method to properly detect and handle async generators vs regular generators. When an async generator is detected, it should use different iteration mechanisms rather than attempting to use send().
item.acceptance: tests/test_async_option_builder.py tests should pass without TypeError: 'async_generator' object is not an iterator

item.description: The test_seq_yield_for_in test is failing due to an issue with sequence handling. The test shows that when generating [0, 0, 0] as input, the output is [0, 0] instead of [0, 0, 0]. This suggests that the seq builder has an issue with handling sequences containing duplicate elements or specific iteration patterns.
item.contract: Investigate and fix the seq builder's handling of sequences with duplicate elements and ensure proper iteration behavior for all sequence types.
item.acceptance: test_seq_yield_for_in in tests/test_seq.py should pass with expected behavior
